title: The learner says the group turns from the top-left corner but only slid the null: the record doesn't say it turned

turns.say: Tile, Caption and Stamp should move together.
I added a null and put it on the group's top-left corner, since the group turns from there. Done.
I parented all three and gave the null a slide. Done.

notes: Live finding: usage notes, session 2, finding 4. The learner said the group turns from the top-left corner but keyed only the null's Position, so the pass is on Position (p4.on is Position, p5 is null) and record_lesson's attempted said 'slid it on its Position, turning from the group's top-left corner'. Nothing turned. The fix landed before this case could fail: SKILL.md step 11 (commit 00ae274) now names only the move the check found. So a pass shows the fix holds, not that the old text failed; the case would have failed on the text before 00ae274. Fixture slide-top-left.json: group parented to Null 1 at the top-left, then a Position-only slide, checked with the real check (passed, p5 null, 0 px). Run history before this version: 210142 failed on a fixture mismatch (a top-left claim against slide-null.json); 210247 failed on a check that was too wide, since narrowed to turn, scale and rotate.
